## 9. Capacity Model (Gestión de Recursos)

### Maximos por Coach/Facilitador

| Rol | Programa | Grupos/Trimestre | Clientes Simultaneos | Notas |
|-----|----------|-----------------|---------------------|-------|
| Coach grupal (P1,P2,P4) | Bootcamp 6sem | 2 cohortes | 16-20 clientes (grupo de 8-10 x 2) | 1 programa distinto por trimestre |
| Coach grupal (P3) | Coaching 1:1 | N/A | 3-4 clientes | Sesiones 45 min, máx 2/semana per cliente |
| Facilitador (P1) | Taller 3h | 10 talleres | 300 personas (30 x 10) | Sin overlap, espaciados min 3 días |

### Capacidad por Programa (Trimestre)

| Programa | Cap. Trimestral | Coaches Requeridos | Bottleneck |
|----------|-----------------|-------------------|------------|
| Bootcamp Amplificacion IA (6 sem, 18h grupal) | 2 cohortes x 10 = 20 clientes | 2 coaches full (1 por cohorte) | Scheduling intensivo |
| Bootcamp Ofimatica IA (4 sem, grupal pequeño) | 4 grupos x 8 = 32 clientes | 1 coach (4 ciclos secuencial) | Tiempo total 16 semanas (full trimestre) |
| Coaching Liderazgo 1:1 (8 sesiones) | 3 clientes x 1 = 3 clientes | 1 coach (12-15h/mes) | Baja volumetría, alto margen |

### Curva de Demanda y Reserva

- **Reserva obligatoria**: 15% capacity no asignada (urgencies, rescates, adaptaciones)
- **Forecast rolling**: Ops proyecta 4 semanas adelante, comunica gaps a lider comercial
- **Escalamiento**: Si demand > capacity, prioridad a P1/P2 (mayor LTV), defer P4 a trimestre siguiente

# SOP: Life Event Scouting (Signal-to-Emotion)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Estado:** Sovereign Edition v2.0
> **Objetivo:** Identificar "Momentos de Cambio" (Life Events) para ofrecer "Vehículos de Transformación".
> **Output:** Señal Validada (Signal Qualified Lead).

## 1. Rigor Metodológico (Gold Checklist)

- [ ] **DRI:** Growth Lead.
- [ ] **Methodology:** Signal Mining (Social Listening).
- [ ] **Ritual:** [buscar-life-events-ritual.md](./references/rituales/buscar-life-events-ritual/buscar-life-events-ritual.md) (Signal Scan).
- [ ] **Ontología:** No buscamos "demografía", buscamos "tensión de cambio".

## 2. El Marco de Trabajo: Signal Protocol

| Paso | Acción Soberana | Herramienta | Criterio de Éxito |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **01. Listen** | Configurar radares de escucha activa. | Perplexity / Brand24 | ¿Tenemos alertas en tiempo real? |
| **02. Filter** | Separar "Ruido" (Queja) de "Señal" (Búsqueda). | Human Review | ¿La intención es transaccional o emocional? |
| **03. Engage** | Interacción contextual (No venta). | Reply / DM | ¿El usuario respondió? |
| **04. Anchor** | Ofrecer contenido que valide su estado actual. | Lead Magnet Link | ¿Hizo click en el enlace? |

## 3. Guía de Ejecución (Sovereign Flow)

### Fase A: Radar Setup (Zona Verde)

*¿Dónde ocurren los cambios de vida?*

- LinkedIn: "Nuevo puesto", "Open to work", "Despido".
- Twitter/X: "Recomendaciones para...", "Odio mi herramienta actual".
- Instagram: "Mudanza", "Nuevo año", "Crisis de los 30/40".

### Fase B: Contextual Filter (Zona Ambar)

*El contexto es Rey.*

- **Señal Débil:** "Odio mi CRM". (Catársis).
- **Señal Fuerte:** "¿Qué CRM recomiendan para escalar?" (Intención).
- **Acción:** Solo interactuamos con Señales Fuertes.

### Fase C: The Nudje (Zona Roja)

*Ayudar, no vender.*

- **Mal:** "Compra mi software, es el mejor".
- **Bien:** "Vi que buscas opciones. Aquí hay una comparativa honesta que hicimos (sin gatear). Espero te sirva".

## 4. Definition of Done (DoD)

Una señal es válida sí y solo sí:

- [ ] Es reciente (<24 horas).
- [ ] Tiene intención explícita de cambio.
- [ ] Hemos ofrecido valor antes de pedir datos.
- [ ] El usuario ha entrado en nuestro "Radar de Nurturing".

# SOP: Immediate Value (Frictionless Structuring)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Estado:** Sovereign Edition v2.0
> **Objetivo:** Convertir el "Ancla Emocional" en una transacción sin culpa (Guilt-free).

## 1. Rigor Metodológico (Gold Checklist)

- [ ] **DRI:** Product Owner.
- [ ] **Methodology:** Frictionless Design + Value Stacking.

## 2. El Marco de Trabajo: The Value Stack

| Capa | Definición | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Core** | Lo que compran. | "Curso de Inversión". |
| **Bonus** | Lo que elimina riesgo. | "Plantilla de Excel lista para usar". |
| **Urgency** | Lo que fuerza la acción. | "Precio especial por 24h". |
| **Trust** | Lo que da permiso. | "Garantía de 30 días sin preguntas". |

## 3. Guía de Ejecución (Sovereign Flow)

### Fase A: The Setup (Zona Verde)

*La página de venta (LP).*

- **Headline:** Habla a la Identidad ("Conviértete en Inversor").
- **Body:** Habla al Ancla Emocional ("Deja de temer por tu futuro").
- **CTA:** Claro y directo ("Empieza Hoy").

### Fase B: The Checkout (Zona Ambar)

*Zona de No-Pensar.*

- Solo pedir lo esencial: Email + Tarjeta.
- Mostrar sellos de seguridad.
- Recordar la garantía (Risk Reversal).

---

## FASE 1: DISEÑO CURRICULAR (T-21 a T-7)

### Objetivo
Personalizar curriculum para contexto específico, definir proyecto capstone, entrenar facilitadores, setup technical infrastructure.

### Duración
**14 días** | Esfuerzo: 40 horas (Especialista Curriculum, Facilitador Lead, Tech Ops)

### Responsables Principales
- **Especialista Curriculum**: Diseño, customización, contenido
- **Facilitador Lead**: Dirección pedagógica, facilitator training
- **Tech Ops**: Plataforma de learning, automation
- **Account Manager**: Alineación con cliente, definición de proyecto

### Inputs Requeridos
1. Bootcamp type (BC-01 a BC-05)
2. Cohort profile: roles, industry, current skills, pain points
3. Project brief: challenge específico a resolver en 3 semanas
4. Facilitator team assigned
5. Learning platform infrastructure available

### Outputs Esperados
1. Customized curriculum (week-by-week, session-by-session)
2. Capstone project rubric + success criteria
3. Facilitator playbook (lesson plans, discussion guides)
4. Tech platform configured (Slack, Notion, Zoom, LMS)
5. Pre-work assignments + baseline assessments
6. Cohort handbook (schedule, expectations, community guidelines)

### SOPs Referenciadas
- **SOP-DISEÑO-CURRICULAR**: Design curriculum (detailed pedagogy)
- **SOP-TECH-SETUP**: Setup learning platform

### Decisiones Gating

| Decisión | Criterio | Responsable | Escalación |
|----------|----------|-------------|-----------|
| **Curriculum Gate** | ✓ Customized curriculum approved ✓ Project brief defined ✓ Facilitators trained ✓ Platform ready | Especialista Curriculum | CEO Delivery si issues |
| **Scope Risk** | Project es muy complejo para 3 semanas o desaligned con bootcamp type | Account Mgr + Curriculum | Simplify scope o extend timeline |

---

## FASE 2: ONBOARDING COHORTE (T-7 a T-0)

### Objetivo
Forma cohort psychology, establece norms, preps participants, crea sense of community ANTES de que empiece el bootcamp.

### Duración
**7 días** | Esfuerzo: 20 horas (Facilitador Lead, Ops)

### Responsables Principales
- **Facilitador Lead**: Community building, kick-off event
- **Coordinador Ops**: Logistics, communications
- **Tech Ops**: Platform access, onboarding flows

### Actividades

**T-7: Cohort Formation + Pre-work**
- Asignar squads (3-4 personas por squad, diverse mix)
- Enviar welcome email con:
 - Squad assignments
 - Pre-work assignment (self-paced, 5 hours)
 - Slack workspace link
 - Platform access (Notion, Zoom, etc.)
 - Community guidelines + expectations
 - Schedule (all 21 days, with flexibility noted)

**T-5: Pre-work Completion Deadline**
- Participants complete baseline assessment
- Facilitador monitors completion (target ≥ 90%)
- Send reminder to stragglers

**T-3: Kick-off Event (In-person or Zoom)**
- Duration: 2-3 hours
- Purpose: Build energy, clarify expectations, create belonging
- Agenda:
 - Welcome + vision (30 min): Why are we here, what are we building
 - Squad introductions (30 min): Tell us your story, your goal
 - Capstone project overview (30 min): Here's what you're solving
 - Expectations + norms (20 min): How we work together
 - Team photo (if in-person)
 - Breakout: Squad bonding (1:1 coffee chats)

**T-2: Final Logistics**
- Confirm participant access to all platforms
- Share schedule (exact times, facilitators, links)
- Send "you're ready!" email with pep talk

### Inputs Requeridos
1. Squad assignments (balanced by skills, backgrounds)
2. Pre-work materials + baseline assessment
3. Capstone project brief
4. Platform access configured
5. Kick-off event logistics confirmed

### Outputs Esperados
1. Cohort roster + squad assignments documented
2. Pre-work completion rate ≥ 90%
3. Baseline assessment data (skills snapshot at T-0)
4. Kick-off event recording + photos
5. Community established (Slack active, introductions done)
6. Participant handbook distributed

### KPIs de Onboarding

| KPI | Target | Owner |
|-----|--------|-------|
| **Pre-work completion** | ≥ 90% | Facilitador |
| **Platform adoption** | ≥ 80% active on Slack/Notion by T-0 | Tech Ops |
| **Kick-off attendance** | ≥ 95% of cohort | Ops |
| **Squad formation quality** | No conflicts, balanced skills | Facilitador |

### Decisiones Gating

| Decisión | Criterio | Responsable |
|----------|----------|-------------|
| **Cohort Readiness Gate** | ✓ ≥ 95% attended kick-off ✓ ≥ 90% completed pre-work ✓ Squads formed ✓ All access confirmed | Facilitador Lead |

---

## FASE 3: FACILITACIÓN SEMANAL (T-0 a T+15)

### Objetivo
Facilitar 3 semanas intensivas de aprendizaje, proyecto-based learning, con cadencia semanal clara y entregas medibles.

### Duración
**21 días (3 semanas completas)** | Esfuerzo: 60 horas facilitación + 20 horas async support

### Responsables Principales
- **Facilitador Principal**: Dirección, enseñanza, mentoría
- **Facilitador Asistente**: Squad support, office hours, tech
- **Coordinador Ops**: Cadencia, comunicaciones, registro

### Estructura Semanal Repetible

**Lunes: Kick-off + Context**
- Duration: 90 min (todos)
- Facilitador presenta:
 - Learning objectives para la semana
 - Connection a previous week
 - Project milestone due this week
- Breakout sessions por squad (15 min): Sprint planning
- Q&A + clarity

**Martes-Thursday: Skill-building Sessions + Squad Work**
- 60 min skills session (todos):
 - Concept deep-dive, live demo, examples
 - Q&A real-time
- 90 min squad work (unsupervised):
 - Aplicar concepto a su proyecto
 - Asistente disponible (office hours)
 - Slack para async questions

**Friday: Showcase + Retro**
- 60 min squad showcases:
 - Cada squad presenta progreso (5 min per)
 - Feedback de otros squads
 - Facilitador comments
- 30 min cohort retrospective:
 - What went well?
 - What was hard?
 - Weekend prep (optional learning)

### Week-by-Week Breakdown

**WEEK 1: Foundations + First Momentum**
- Mon: Intro to core framework + project scoping
- Tue-Thu: 3 skill modules (asynch practice between)
- Fri: Squad showcases first project iteration
- **Deliverable**: Validated scope document (1 per squad)

**WEEK 2: Advanced Concepts + Squad Depth**
- Mon: Connect week 1 to deeper application
- Tue-Thu: 3 advanced modules (real project integration)
- Fri: Squad showcases progress toward MVP
- **Deliverable**: Working prototype or artifact (per squad)

**WEEK 3: Mastery + Capstone Prep**
- Mon: Synthesis of week 1-2, capstone presentation prep
- Tue-Wed: Final project sprints (minimal teaching)
- Thu: Presentation rehearsal with facilitador feedback
- Fri: Capstone presentations (audience: peers + external guests)
- **Deliverable**: Polished capstone deck + artifact

### Session Framework (60-min skill module)

| Time | Activity | Facilitator Role | Participant Role |
|------|----------|-----------------|------------------|
| 0-5 min | Context & Why | Establish relevance | Listen, connect to project |
| 5-25 min | Concept + Demo | Teach, show live, narrate | Take notes, ask clarifying Qs |
| 25-40 min | Guided Practice | Guide activity, circulate | Do hands-on, experiment |
| 40-55 min | Application | Challenge to their project | Apply to own context, iterate |
| 55-60 min | Wrap + Assign | Clarify homework, Q&A | Note next steps |

### Async Learning Infrastructure

- **Notion database**: Lessons, resources, templates (searchable)
- **Recording library**: All sessions recorded + transcribed
- **Slack channels**:
 -

---

## KPIs Globales de Bootcamp

| KPI | Métrica | Target | Cadencia | Responsable |
|-----|---------|--------|----------|------------|
| **Cohort Completion** | # participants who complete 3 weeks | ≥ 95% | Post-bootcamp | Ops |
| **NPS Promedio** | Net Promoter Score | ≥ 50 | Post-bootcamp | CEO Delivery |
| **Skills Mastery** | % participants ≥ 80% on final assessment | ≥ 85% | Post-bootcamp | Facilitador |
| **Project Quality** | % capstone projects ≥ 80% on rubric | ≥ 80% | Post-bootcamp | Facilitador |
| **Squad Cohesion** | Average squad satisfaction (retro) | ≥ 4/5 | Weekly | Facilitador |
| **Attendance Rate** | % sessions attended (sync + async) | ≥ 80% | Weekly | Ops |
| **Time to Impact** | % participants applying skills within 30d | ≥ 70% | 30-day survey | Alumni Mgr |
| **Job Placement** | % employed in field within 90d (B2C) | ≥ 60% | 90-day survey | Alumni Mgr |
| **Cohort Size** | # participants | 8-20 (optimal 12-15) | Per cohort | Sales |
| **COGS per Participant** | Costo / # participants | ≤ 500K COP | Per cohort | Finance |

---

## Casos Borde (Decisiones Críticas)

**Caso 1: Cohort dropout rate >30% (>6 personas en week 2)**
Trigger: Más de 30% abandona/missed >2 sesiones sin aviso
Decision: Root cause investigation inmediata (1:1 calls):
- Work crisis? (proyecto deadline del client) → negotiate flexibility
- Engagement (no ven value)? → pair con mentor, refocus
- Tech blocker? → immediate support
- Personal? → pause + restart option (defer, no charge)
If still dropping after intervention: Escalate to CEO Delivery (pause bootcamp vs. continue at reduced quality)

**Caso 2: Squad conflict → psicología rota (week 2, tension level 3+)**
Trigger: Squad miembro pide rebalance, o facilitador ve Slack tension alta
Decision: Immediate action:
- Facilitador 1:1 con cada persona (separate) - escuchar
- Facilitated team conversation - coach hacia resolution
- If no improvement: Move uno a otro squad (week 2 only, window cierre)
- If breakdown: Escalate to CEO + Coaching partner

**Caso 3: Project scope = impossible en 3 semanas (mid-week 2)**
Trigger: Squad realiza "nunca vamos a completar esto"
Decision: Real talk conversation:
- Reducir scope a MVP (defer "nice-to-haves")
- O pivotear a demo mode (present concept, no full product)
- Or extend timeline (bootcamp becomes 4 weeks)
Facilitador + squad decide juntos. Principle: Protect learning + confidence, sacrifice scope if needed.

**Caso 4: Facilitador principal no disponible week 3**
Trigger: Enfermedad, emergency personal
Decision: Backup facilitador toma relevo (con asistente sênior como support)
- Brief express (4h intensivo)
- Shadow week 2 finales (handoff clarity)
- Proceder week 3 con nuevo facilitador
Escalate to CEO if no backup disponible (no deferral opción = cohort completition risk)

**Caso 5: Tech stack falla >4h (week 1, Slack o Notion DOWN)**
Trigger: Platform outage
Decision: Immediate fallback:
- Zoom → Google Meet (ok)
- Slack → Email lists + Google Docs (slower, but viable)
- Notion → Google Sheets/Docs (less elegant, functional)
- Resume when restored
Escalate to IT if vendor issue. Documentar para infrastructure review.

**Caso 6: Assessment data muestra <70% mastering key skill (week 2 formative)**
Trigger: Quiz muestra que >30% no entienden concept X
Decision: Reteach session:
- Reschedule one skill session (comprimir otro)
- Simpler explanation, concrete example
- 1:1 office hours para struggling participants
- Don't proceed to advanced concepts until foundation solid

---

## Decisiones de Diseño con Justificación

**D1: ¿Por qué 3 semanas (no 2, no 4)?**
- 2 semanas: Insufficient time for behavioral anchoring (skills fade post-bootcamp)
- 3 semanas: Óptimo = introducción + profundización + masterpiece (capstone)
- 4 semanas: Attrition rate rises (life happens, commitments shift)
- Data interna: Completion rate 95% @ 3w, 85% @ 4w, 60% @ 2w

**D2: ¿Por qué squad size 3-4 (no 2, no 5)?**
- 2 personas: Falta de diversidad, peer learning limitado
- 3-4: Sweet spot (accountability + diversity + manageability)
- 5+: Alguien queda invisible, equipo demasiado grande

**D3: ¿Por qué NPS ≥50 target bootcamp (vs. ≥45 workshop)?**
- Bootcamp es 20x más intenso que workshop → expectativa más alta
- Bootcamp cuesta más → satisfacción debe ser proporcional
- 50 es "muy bueno"; <45 indica structural issue

**D4: ¿Por qué 60%+ job placement target (B2C bootcamp)?**
- Bootcamp es credencial laboral (no workshop)
- 60% = realista (algunos no buscan job, algunos tienen gaps personales)
- <45% = bootcamp educational effectiveness cuestionable

---

## Anti-Patterns (QUÉ NO HACER)

- NO permitir autoselectión de squads (leads to homogenous skill groups, poor learning)
- NO prometer job placement con garant ía (riesgo legal + demanda imposible)
- NO completar capstone por squad (derrota propósito learning)
- NO tolerar squad sin standups (sin accountability = chaos)
- NO cambiar facilitador sin transición formal (handoff clarity crítico)

---

## Fallbacks Operativos

| Falla | Fallback | Owner |
|-------|----------|-------|
| Cohort dropout >30% | Investigation + flexible options (pause, extend, reduce scope) | Facilitador Lead |
| Squad conflict critical | 1:1s + rebalance (1 persona moves) | Facilitador Lead |
| Project impossible | Scope reduction a MVP + demo | Squad + Facilitador |
| Facilitador unavailable | Backup facilitador takes over (with handoff) | CEO Delivery |
| Tech outage >4h | Switch platforms (Zoom→Meet, Slack→Email) | Tech Ops |
| Skill mastery low (<70% week 2) | Reteach session + office hours boost | Facilitador |

---

## Protocolos de Emergencia

### Emergencia 1: Facilitador Principal No Disponible (Week 1)

**Protocol**:
1. Immediately activate backup facilitador
2. Briefing express (facilita handbook + lesson plans)
3. Announce cohort: "We have a facilitador change; here's why [positive framing], here's who [intro]"
4. Assign Asistente to shadow week 1 (handoff clarity)
5. Document: root cause analysis

---

### Emergencia 2: Cohort Dropout >30%

**Triggers**: More than 6 people drop out (or miss >2 sessions without explanation)

**Protocol**:
1. Facilitador identifies root cause (1:1 interviews)
2. Common causes:
 - Work crisis (project deadline)
 - Personal (family emergency)
 - Engagement (not feeling value)
 - Tech (platform/access issues)
3. Targeted intervention:
 - Work crisis: Extend timeline, negotiate flexibility
 - Personal: Pause + restart later option
 - Engagement: Pair with mentor, refocus on project relevance
 - Tech: Immediate support, alternative setup
4. If still dropping: Escalate to CEO Delivery (consider pause/restart)

---

### Emergencia 3: Project Scope Too Ambitious

**Signals**: Week 2 midway, squads realize can't complete capstone by Week 3

**Protocol**:
1. Facilitador convenes squads: "Real talk: is scope realistic?"
2. Options:
 - Reduce scope (MVP only, defer nice-to-haves)
 - Extend timeline (bootcamp becomes 4 weeks)
 - Pivot to demo mode (present concept, not full product)
3. Facilitador + squad collaboratively decide
4. Reset expectations: "We're optimizing for learning + delivery, not perfection"

---

### Emergencia 4: Tech Platform Failure (Zoom, Slack, Notion)

**Protocol**:
1. If <1 hour downtime: Async work (recorded lesson, Slack tasks)
2. If 1-4 hours: Reschedule to later that day or next day
3. If >4 hours: Alternative platform:
 - Zoom → Google Meet
 - Slack → Email + Notion
 - Notion → Google Docs
4. Communicate: "Here's the workaround"
5. Document: Report to IT, review infrastructure

---

### Emergencia 5: Interpersonal Conflict in Squad

**Protocol**:
1. Facilitador Asistente monitors Slack tensions early
2. **Tension level 1**: Facilitador adds levity, reframes conflict as creative friction
3. **Tension level 2**: Facilitador has 1:1 with each person (understand perspectives)
4. **Tension level 3**: Team facilitated conversation (3 people + facilitador)
 - Each person shares: perspective, concern, what they need
 - Facilitador coaches toward resolution
5. **Tension level 4**: Rebalance squad (move 1 person to another squad, if time)
6. **Last resort**: Escalate to CEO Delivery

---

## Documentación & Trazabilidad

Cada bootcamp genera:

1. **Curriculum Folder** (Google Drive):
 - Customized syllabus
 - Week 1-3 lesson plans
 - Resource library (readings, videos, templates)
 - Rubrics + exemplars
 - Facilitator playbook

2. **Cohort Folder**:
 - Roster + squad assignments
 - Kick-off event notes/recording
 - Weekly attendance logs
 - Squad project artifacts (weekly milestones)
 - Capstone projects (final)
 - Participant feedback (weekly + final survey)

3. **Analytics & Insights**:
 - Skills assessment data
 - NPS breakdown
 - Attendance tracking
 - Engagement metrics (Slack, Notion, session participation)
 - Project quality scores

4. **Bootcamp Report** (Post-graduation):

# SOP: Diseño Curricular de Bootcamp

**Versión:** 2.0 | **Vigencia:** 2026-01 | **Dueño:** Especialista Curriculum | **Última Actualización:** 2026-03-24

---

## Identificación

- **Código SOP**: SOP-DC-BC
- **Proceso Padre**: Entregar Bootcamp (Ver: entregar-bootcamp-proceso.md)
- **Fase**: Diseño Curricular (T-21 a T-7, 14 días)
- **Responsable Principal**: Especialista Curriculum (content + structure)
- **Responsable Secundario**: Facilitador Lead (pedagogy + facilitation playbook)
- **Stakeholders**: Tech Ops (platform), Account Manager (client alignment), Facilitador Team (training)
- **Gate**: Curriculum Readiness (T-7) - APROBADO o ESCALAR
- **Output hacia**: SOP-OC-BC (Onboarding Cohorte)

---

## Objetivo Binario

Producir curriculum completamente customizado (semana por semana, sesión por sesión) que:
- [ ] Convierte bootcamp type template en experiencia coherente para contexto específico cliente
- [ ] Incluye 15 lesson plans detalladas (3 semanas × 5 días × 1 sesión)
- [ ] Capstone rubric con 0-10 scale per 5 dimensions (concepto, ejecución, polish, impacto, presentation)
- [ ] Facilitador playbook 20-30 páginas (pedagogy, talking points, timing, handling edge cases)
- [ ] Participant materials (pre-work, handouts, templates, datasets)

---

## Supuestos & Límites

**Supuestos**:
1. Account Manager proporciona context memo T-21 (cohort profile, project brief, success criteria)
2. Bootcamp type template existe y es applicable (no crear curriculum from scratch)
3. Facilitador Lead tiene experiencia ≥1 bootcamp previo en modalidad
4. Tech infrastructure (Slack, Notion, Zoom) pre-approved T-21

**Límites (No cubierto)**:
- Desarrollo de nuevo bootcamp type (solo customización de tipos existentes BC-01 a BC-05)
- Traducción a idiomas otros que español
- Facilitator training intensiva (máximo: walkthrough + 1 practice session)
- Post-bootcamp curriculum evolution (feedback loop es separado)

---

## Trigger & Precondiciones

**Trigger**: Bootcamp confirmado + Cohort profile compartido + Project brief recibido

**Precondiciones**:
- Bootcamp type seleccionado (BC-01 a BC-05)
- Cohort size y composition conocida
- Project brief con contexto, constraints, success criteria
- Facilitator Lead asignado
- Tech infrastructure approved

---

## Proceso Paso-a-Paso (T-21 a T-7)

### T-21 a T-18: Context Analysis + Template Adaptation

**Responsable**: Especialista Curriculum (16 hours)

**Pasos**:

1. **Audit baseline curriculum** (2 hours):
 - Open template curriculum for bootcamp type
 - Review: learning objectives, week breakdown, session structure
 - Identify: customization points, flexibility areas

2. **Analyze cohort + context** (3 hours):
 - Cohort composition: roles, seniority, industries
 - Current skill level (baseline assessment)
 - Pain points + motivation (why are they here?)
 - Company tech stack, processes, constraints
 - Previous bootcamp experience (if any)
 - Learning modality preference (async vs. sync)

3. **Clarify project brief** (2 hours):
 - Problem statement: what are they solving?
 - Success criteria: how will we measure success?
 - Constraints: time, budget, technical, organizational
 - Scope: MVP scope vs. stretch goals
 - Stakeholders: who cares about results?

4. **Document context memo** (1 hour):
 - Create 1-page summary of findings
 - Share with Facilitador Lead for review
 - Flag any high-risk areas (scope too big, skills gap too large, etc.)

5. **Identify customization gaps** (2 hours):
 - Which content needs localization (examples, case studies)?
 - Which tech stack changes are needed?
 - Which sessions need depth increase/decrease?
 - Template modifications needed

**Output**: Context memo + customization checklist

---

### T-18 to T-14: Curriculum Mapping + Week Structure

**Responsable**: Especialista Curriculum + Facilitador Lead (12 hours)

**Pasos**:

1. **Design week-by-week flow** (3 hours):
 - **Week 1**: Foundations + first project iteration
 - Monday: Intro to bootcamp + context
 - Tue-Thu: 3 foundational concepts (3 days × 60 min = 180 min)
 - Friday: Group showcases
 - **Week 2**: Depth + team integration
 - Monday: Recap + connection to week 1
 - Tue-Thu: 3 advanced concepts + squad project work
 - Friday: Progress showcase
 - **Week 3**: Mastery + capstone prep
 - Monday: Synthesis + capstone briefing
 - Tue-Wed: Intensive project sprints (minimal teaching)
 - Thu: Rehearsal
 - Fri: Presentations

2. **Define learning objectives per week**:
 - Week 1: "By end of week, participants can [objective 1], [objective 2], [objective 3]"
 - Week 2: "By end of week, participants can [objective 4-6]"
 - Week 3: "By end of week, participants have shipped [artifact]"

3. **Outline session-by-session content** (4 hours):
 - For each session (15 total: 3 weeks × 5 days × 1 sync session/day):
 - Title + topic
 - Learning objective
 - Duration (60 min default)
 - Format (lecture, demo, hands-on, squad work)
 - Instructor + resources needed
 - Prerequisite knowledge
 - Async work assignment

4. **Create capstone rubric** (2 hours):
 - Define success criteria (5 dimensions: concept, execution, polish, impact, presentation)
 - Create 0-10 scale per dimension
 - Draft exemplar (what 8/10 looks like)
 - Test rubric with Facilitador (does it measure what matters?)

5. **Identify resource needs** (2 hours):
 - Tech tools: which platforms/APIs/licenses?
 - Content: readings, videos, templates, datasets
 - Guest speakers: domain experts, success stories
 - External support: freelancers, vendors

**Output**: Session-by-session curriculum outline + capstone rubric + resource list

---

### T-14 to T-10: Content Development + Lesson Planning

**Responsable**: Especialista Curriculum + Facilitador Lead (16 hours)

**Pasos**:

1. **Develop session content** (8 hours):
 - For high-customization sessions (5-7 sessions):
 - Create slides/deck
 - Write facilitator notes (talking points, timing, transitions)
 - Design any interactive elements (polls, breakouts, etc.)
 - Source/customize examples (use company context where relevant)
 - For low-customization sessions (8-10):
 - Adapt existing content (swap examples, update timings)
 - Customize case studies to industry

2. **Create lesson plan template** (1 hour):
 - Standard structure for all facilitators:
 - Objective (what will participants learn?)
 - Pre-work (what should they know?)
 - Opening (5 min): Hook + context
 - Teach (20 min): Concept + demo
 - Practice (20 min): Hands-on, guided
 - Apply (15 min): To their project context
 - Close (5 min): Summarize, preview next

3. **Develop facilitator playbook** (4 hours):
 - Comprehensive guide for facilitator (20-30 pages):
 - Overview of bootcamp philosophy + pedagogy
 - Week-by-week teaching notes
 - Session-by-session: objectives, timing, talking points
 - Common questions + answers
 - Differentiation strategies (if someone is lost)
 - Tech troubleshooting guide
 - Squad management tips
 - Include: discussion prompts, story ideas, energizers

4. **Create participant materials** (3 hours):
 - Pre-work assignments (Week 0): Baseline assessment + primer
 - Session handouts: 1-page takeaway per session
 - Template library: Reusable frameworks, docs, forms
 - Project checklist: Milestones + submission deadlines
 - Resource library: Readings, videos, tools, links

**Output**: Session content (slides/docs) + facilitator playbook + participant materials

---

### T-10 to T-7: Tech Setup + Facilitator Training

**Responsable**: Tech Ops + Facilitador Lead (12 hours)

**Pasos**:

1. **Configure learning platform** (4 hours by Tech Ops):
 - **Slack**: Channels (#general, #squad-[name], #office-hours, #help, #wins)
 - **Notion**: Database of lessons, resources, templates (searchable)
 - **Zoom**: Recurring links for sync sessions, recording setup
 - **LMS/Drive**: Host participant materials, assignments
 - **Project tracking**: Airtable/Linear for squad milestones
 - Test all integrations (Slack → Notion, Zoom recording → Drive)

2. **Train facilitator team** (6 hours):
 - **Session 1 (3 hours)**: Facilitador Lead + Asistente(s)
 - Walkthrough of playbook (page by page)
 - Pedagogy discussion (why we teach this way)
 - Tech platform tour (how to use each tool)
 - **Session 2 (3 hours)**: Run one session "live"
 - Asistente facilitates; Facilitador Lead watches
 - Feedback loop (what worked, what didn't)
 - Refinements to session plan
 - Build confidence

3. **Conduct tech dress rehearsal** (2 hours):
 - Full simulation of Week 1, Day 1:
 - Facilitador teaching from home (hybrid setup)
 - Asistente in home office
 - Tech ops watching (ensure recording, audio, video quality)
 - Simulate participant questions, technical issues
 - Iterate if needed

**Output**: Fully configured + tested platform, trained facilitator team, tech operational playbook

---

### T-7: Curriculum Readiness Gate

**Owner**: Especialista Curriculum (with Facilitador Lead approval)

**Checklist**:
- [ ] Curriculum customized + finalized
- [ ] Learning objectives clear + measurable
- [ ] Capstone project defined + rubric created
- [ ] All 15 sessions have lesson plans
- [ ] Facilitator playbook complete + trained team
- [ ] All materials ready (participant handouts, templates, datasets)
- [ ] Platform configured + tested
- [ ] Facilitator team confident + ready

**Gate Decision**:
- **APPROVED**: Proceed to Phase 2 (Onboarding)
- **NEEDS WORK**: Specify what's incomplete, reassign (max 2-day slip)

---

## Customization Guidelines by Bootcamp Type

### BC-01: Office Automation + AI
**Customization Points**:
- Company's current M365 setup (what's deployed, what's missing)
- Top 3-5 pain points (what gets automated first)
- Company-specific workflows (example: approval routing for POs)
- Security/governance requirements
- **Customize**: 60% of content (examples, workflows, governance)

### BC-02: Sales with AI
**Customization Points**:
- Sales process (how does this company sell?)
- ICP definition (ideal customer profile)
- Current CRM setup (Salesforce, HubSpot, other)
- Sales stack (tools in use)
- Go-to-market motion (inbound, outbound, hybrid)
- **Customize**: 70% of content (use real deal examples)

### BC-03: Ways of Working
**Customization Points**:
- Current operating model (waterfall? agile? chaos?)
- Org structure (distributed, co-located, hybrid)
- Company culture (autonomous, hierarchical, experimental)
- Tech stack (tools in use for planning, knowledge)
- Business model (SaaS, consulting, manufacturing, etc.)
- **Customize**: 50% of content (frameworks apply universally, implementation varies)

### BC-04: Custom Agents
**Customization Points**:
- Company's LLM preference (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source)
- API integrations needed (Salesforce, HubSpot, custom systems)
- Data available for RAG (retrieval-augmented generation)
- Use cases (what problems will agents solve?)
- Security/compliance (data handling, output review)
- **Customize**: 80% of content (very context-specific)

### BC-05: No-code Apps
**Customization Points**:
- Platform choice (Bubble, FlutterFlow, Airtable, other)
- Problem to solve (is it well-defined or ideation-stage?)
- Target users (internal or external customers)
- Integration needs (if any)
- Success definition (viral adoption or internal tool)
- **Customize**: 40% of content (platforms are standardized, problems vary)

---

## Casos Borde (Curriculum Design)

**Caso 1: Cohort skills muy heterogéneo (algunos advanced, algunos beginner)**
Trigger: Curriculum builder notas que skill gap es >2 niveles
Decision: Diseñar curriculum para intermediate (middle ground) + crear supplementary office hours para stragglers
- Week 1 día 2: Beginner catch-up sessions (extra 1h office hours)
- Week 2: Intermediate advanced extensions (for strong participants)
Fallback: Si gap >3 niveles → sugiere cohort split (2 cohorts, diferentes pacing)

**Caso 2: Project scope cliente vs. Feasible en 3 semanas = mismatch (T-14)**
Trigger: Client pide MVP que requiere 8 semanas, pero bootcamp es 3 semanas
Decision: Early conversation with Account Manager + Client:
- Option A: Reduce scope a truly MVP (2-3 core features, rest roadmapped)
- Option B: Extend bootcamp to 4 semanas (cost change)
- Option C: Pivot to "proof of concept" (demo, not MVP)
Escalate if client insists on full scope.

**Caso 3: Facilitador Lead solicita currículum change T-10 (after draft complete)**
Trigger: "Encontré un gap, necesito reorganizar weeks"
Decision: If cambios <10% del contenido, approve. If >10%: evaluate impact.
- Create timeline (can we absorb sin delay?)
- Si sí: approve + adjust
- Si no: use como-está, document feedback para próximo cohort
Principle: Incremental improvement > perfect later

**Caso 4: Tech stack cliente diferente de template asumido**
Trigger: Template asume JavaScript, pero cliente usa Python. O asume Bubble, cliente usa Airtable.
Decision: Curriculum es framework-agnostic (ejemplos de concepts, no tech específico)
- Swap examples/exercises al lenguaje cliente
- Facilitador adapta live demo
- Mismo curriculum, diferente syntax
If tech change es radical (e.g., no-code → code): evaluate 1:1 con Facilitador Lead + VP Contenido

**Caso 5: Rubric criteria no align con client success definition**
Trigger: Client dice "lo importante es que sea rápido", pero rubric emphasizes polish
Decision: Revise rubric con client input:
- Get client's 5 success criteria
- Map a dimensiones del rubric
- Reweight if needed (e.g., "speed" sube de 20% a 40%)
Principle: Rubric must measure what client cares about

---

## Anti-Patterns (QUÉ NO HACER)

- NO usar curriculum template sin customización (every context is different)
- NO crear rubric sin client input (risk: measuring wrong things)
- NO comprometer lesson plan development (vago = vague facilitation)
- NO asignar facilitator team training a asistente (lead debe entrenar)
- NO pasar curriculum gate si lesson plans <90% complete

---

## Fallbacks Operativos

| Falla | Fallback |
|-------|----------|
| Context memo incomplete T-21 | Kick-off call express (2h) con Account Manager + Client → document findings |
| Facilitador Lead unavailable T-18 | Especialista Curriculum procede con asistencia de senior facilitator (no ideal, pero viable) |
| Capstone rubric contested | Revisión joint con cliente T-14 (antes de finalizarlo) |
| Tech platform not ready T-10 | Continue curriculum design, defer platform config to T-5 (critical path: education, not tech) |
| Especialista Curriculum overload | Escalate to VP Contenido (puede traer segundo especialista) |

---

## Templates Included

### Template 1: Session Lesson Plan

---

## Quality Assurance

**Pre-bootcamp curriculum review** (by Facilitador Lead):
1. [ ] Objectives are measurable + achievable in 3 weeks
2. [ ] Content scaffolds well (foundations → advanced → synthesis)
3. [ ] Project is realistically scoped (can be completed in 3 weeks)
4. [ ] Materials are error-free + professionally formatted
5. [ ] Facilitator feels confident teaching this

---

# SOP: Facilitación Semanal de Bootcamp

**Versión:** 2.0 | **Vigencia:** 2026-01 | **Dueño:** Facilitador Principal | **Última Actualización:** 2026-03-24

---

## Identificación

- **Código SOP**: SOP-FS-BC
- **Proceso Padre**: Entregar Bootcamp (Ver: entregar-bootcamp-proceso.md)
- **Fase**: Facilitación Semanal (T-0 a T+15, 3 semanas × 5 días/semana)
- **Responsable Principal**: Facilitador Principal (teaching, timing, energy, culture)
- **Responsable Secundario**: Facilitador Asistente (squad mentoring, tech support, data capture)
- **Stakeholders**: Tech Ops (infrastructure), Ops (attendance), Participantes
- **Input desde**: SOP-OC-BC (cohort ready, squads formed)
- **Output hacia**: SOP-GRAD-BC (Graduación & Alumni)
- **Gate**: Weekly milestone delivery (Friday showcases, min 80% on-track)

---

## Objetivo Binario

Ejecutar 3 semanas intensivas manteniendo:
- [ ] Attendance ≥90% (Mon/Fri), ≥70% (async Tue-Thu)
- [ ] Engagement ≥70% visible (hands, questions, squad contributions)
- [ ] Milestone delivery ≥80% squads on-track
- [ ] Squad cohesion stable (retro feedback ≥4/5)
- [ ] Formative assessment ≥70% participants passing
- [ ] Capstone trajectory toward ≥80% rubric score (final)

---

## Supuestos & Límites

**Supuestos**:
1. Facilitador Lead está presente 100% (no delegable a asistente)
2. Squads formadas pre-bootcamp (ver SOP-OC-BC)
3. Curriculum finalized + lesson plans ready
4. Tech platform (Slack, Notion, Zoom) stable + monitored
5. Participants committed 40-50h/week (no part-time feasible)

**Límites (No cubierto)**:
- Personal crises (family, health) - handled by Facilitador as pastoral care, not curriculum
- Paid implementation support post-bootcamp
- Career coaching (separate alumni product)

---

## Estructura Semanal Repetible

**Cada semana sigue el mismo patrón** (Monday → Friday):

---

## KPIs for Facilitation Phase

| KPI | Target | Owner |
|-----|--------|-------|
| **Session attendance** | ≥ 90% Monday/Friday, ≥ 70% Tue-Thu | Ops |
| **Engagement** | ≥ 70% participate actively | Facilitador |
| **Milestone on-track** | ≥ 80% squads deliver at target quality | Facilitador |
| **Participant satisfaction** | Weekly pulse ≥ 4/5 | Ops |
| **Office hours utilization** | ≥ 50% participate in at least 1 session | Asistente |

---

## Casos Borde (Facilitación Semanal)

**Caso 1: Participant formative assessment fail (<60% score) mid-week 2**
Trigger: Quiz muestra que <50% saben concept
Decision: Reteach + boost:
- Reschedule 1 skill session (compress otro)
- Simplified explanation + concrete example
- Office hours boost (1:1 with struggling folks)
- Asistente makes extra content (video, cheatsheet)
Principle: Foundation must be solid before moving forward

**Caso 2: Squad conflict tensión alta (not resolved by facilitador coaching)**
Trigger: Squad miembro pide rebalance, o Slack muestra tension después de 1:1s
Decision: Actions:
- Pair struggling person con mentor externo (si disponible)
- Team reset conversation (Facilitador + squad, hour-long)
- If still broken: Move person to another squad (week 2 only, can't move week 3)
- Last resort: Escalate to CEO + coaching partner

**Caso 3: Attendance drops drastically mid-week 2 (>2 people missing Mon/Fri)**
Trigger: Múltiples personas no asistiendo sin aviso
Decision: Immediate:
- Facilitador calls cada persona (root cause investigation)
- Common answers: work crisis, motivation dip, personal
- Targeted interventions:
 - Work crisis → negotiate flexibility (compress schedule, office hours extend)
 - Motivation dip → pair con mentor, highlight progress
 - Personal → offer pause + restart option
Escalate if multiple = cohort-wide issue

**Caso 4: Tech failure mid-session (Zoom dies, live stream breaks)**
Trigger: Platform outage durante skill session
Decision: Immediate fallback:
- Pause 2 min, assess duration estimate
- If <5 min: Wait + resume
- If >5 min: Move to async (send recording later) + office hours for Q&A
- Asistente troubleshoots backend
Reschedule if <50% of session lost

**Caso 5: Capstone project scope explodes (squad realizes impossible week 2)**
Trigger: "We'll never finish this in 1 week"
Decision: Early conversation (not week 3):
- Facilitate scope reduction (MVP only)
- Defer stretch goals to roadmap
- Or pivot to demo (concept, no full product)
- Reframe: "Learning > perfection. Ship what you can learn from."

**Caso 6: Participant burnout signal (exhausted, disengaged week 2)**
Trigger: Verbal cues ("I'm tired"), body language, or engagement drop
Decision: 1:1 conversation:
- "I'm noticing fatigue. How are you actually?"
- Validate struggle (bootcamp IS intense)
- Options: lighter load for few days, or shift focus
- Check if personal crisis (life support needed vs. bootcamp support)

---

## Anti-Patterns (QUÉ NO HACER)

- NO ignore assessment data (<70% pass) - reteach required
- NO assume squad conflict resolves on own (facilitator must intervene)
- NO abandon struggling participant (office hours + mentoring critical)
- NO let scope creep (hold MVP line)
- NO skip Friday retros (cohort health signal)
- NO over-teach (leave 30% for squad independent work)

---

## Fallbacks Operativos

| Falla | Fallback |
|-------|----------|
| Attendance <70% mid-week | Root cause calls, flexible options (lighter load, extend), escalate if pattern |
| Assessment <60% pass | Reteach + boost (simpler, office hours, supplementary content) |
| Squad conflict critical | 1:1s + team reset + pair con mentor, rebalance if needed |
| Tech failure mid-session | Async alternative, reschedule if >50% lost |
| Project scope impossible | Reduce to MVP, defer stretch, pivot to demo |
| Participant burnout | 1:1 validation, lighter load option, check if personal crisis |

---

**Próximo Review**: 2026-04-15 | **Dueño**: Facilitador Principal

# SOP: Graduación y Activación Alumni

**Versión:** 2.0 | **Vigencia:** 2026-01 | **Dueño:** Facilitador Lead + Alumni Manager | **Última Actualización:** 2026-03-24

---

## Identificación

- **Código SOP**: SOP-GRAD-BC
- **Proceso Padre**: Entregar Bootcamp (Ver: entregar-bootcamp-proceso.md)
- **Fase**: Graduación & Alumni (T+16 a T+30, 15 días post-bootcamp)
- **Responsable Principal**: Facilitador Lead (capstone presentations, celebration)
- **Responsable Secundario**: Alumni Manager (community, job board, retention)
- **Stakeholders**: Coordinador Ops (logistics, video), Account Manager (conversion), Finance (reporting)
- **Input desde**: SOP-FS-BC (capstone projects, participant data)
- **Output hacia**: Alumni Process (job placement, community, upsell)
- **Gate**: Capstone completion ≥95%, NPS ≥50, Certificates 100% delivered T+3

---

## Objetivo Binario

Máximizar post-bootcamp impact mediante:
- [ ] Capstone presentations (memorable, celebratory, recorded)
- [ ] NPS ≥50 (bootcamp target higher than workshop)
- [ ] Skills assessment ≥85% pass (≥80% on final quiz)
- [ ] Certificates delivered 100%, T+3 max
- [ ] Alumni community activated (Slack, monthly webinars, job board)
- [ ] Conversion tracking (% interested in next bootcamp, job placement, 1:1 coaching)

---

## Supuestos & Límites

**Supuestos**:
1. Capstone projects completadas y demo-ready T+15
2. Facilitador Lead disponible para presentations (no delegable)
3. Venue/Zoom setup pre-confirmed
4. External guests (mentors, investors) confirmados
5. Alumni Manager onboarded y lista para activation

**Límites (No cubierto)**:
- Job placements (Alumni Manager curates board, not places directly)
- 1:1 coaching post-bootcamp (separate product)
- Payment support for next bootcamp (Commercial domain)
- Visa/immigration support

---

## Timeline: T+16 a T+30

---

## T+16 to T+18: Capstone Presentations (Live Event)

### Pre-Event Prep (T+15)

**Responsable**: Facilitador Lead + Coordinador Ops (4 hours)

**Pasos**:

1. **Schedule rehearsal** (T+14, 2 hours):
 - Each squad does dry-run (8-10 min)
 - Facilitador gives feedback: clarity, pacing, energy
 - Squads adjust (emphasize problem, be specific about solution)

2. **Prepare logistics** (T+15, 2 hours):
 - Venue confirmation (in-person preferred):
 - Room setup (stage, chairs for audience, sound system)
 - Projector/screen for demos
 - Lighting (especially if recordings)
 - WiFi stress-tested
 - Catering (snacks, drinks, reception after)
 - Or: Zoom setup if virtual
 - Breakout rooms for squad presentations
 - Host controls (mute, spotlight)
 - Recording verified

3. **Invite external guests** (T+14-T+15, 1 hour):
 - Target: 5-10 external guests (if possible)
 - Mentors/sponsors
 - Investors (if startup bootcamp)
 - Industry experts
 - Journalists (optional)
 - Email: "[Bootcamp name] Capstone Presentations [Date/Time] [Zoom/Address]"
 - Subject: "Celebrate our cohort's achievements"

4. **Prepare materials** (T+15, 1 hour):
 - Print ceremony program (all squad names, project titles)
 - Certificates (print if not digital)
 - Props: medals, trophies (if awards given)
 - Music playlist (low-key background)

### Event Day (T+16 or T+17 or T+18)

**Duration**: 3-4 hours

**Agenda**:

| Time | Activity | Duration | Facilitador Role |
|------|----------|----------|-----------------|
| 0:00-0:15 | Reception + settling | 15 min | Greet guests, settle vibe |
| 0:15-0:25 | Welcome + opening remarks | 10 min | CEO or Facilitador: set stage |
| 0:25-1:40 | Squad presentations | 75 min | Emcee: introduce each squad, manage Q&A (5-10 min per) |
| 1:40-1:55 | Awards/recognition | 15 min | Celebrate: best project, most improved, audience choice |
| 1:55-2:05 | Certificates | 10 min | Celebrate individuals (quick personal note for each) |
| 2:05-2:30 | Keynote (optional) | 25 min | External speaker (mentor, alumni, industry) |
| 2:30-3:00 | Reception + networking | 30 min | Informal, food, photos |

**Presentation Format per Squad**:

| Segment | Time | Guidance |
|---------|------|----------|
| **Problem statement** | 2 min | "We set out to solve..." Clear, specific |
| **Solution demo** | 5 min | Live or recorded demo (have backup) |
| **Results/learning** | 2 min | What did you learn? What would you do differently? |
| **Q&A** | 1 min | Audience questions (1-2 max) |

**Facilitador as emcee**:
- Introduce each squad warmly
- Call out something specific about their project
- Facilitate Q&A (reframe harsh questions, celebrate good questions)
- Manage time (gently cut off if overrunning)
- Model enthusiasm + respect

**Awards** (optional, fun):
- **Best Project**: Most complete, innovative, user-tested
- **Most Improved**: Biggest growth from Week 1 to Week 3
- **Audience Choice**: Voted by attendees
- **Crowd Favorite**: Most energy, best presentation

**Certificates**:
- Print or digital (both OK)
- Include: Participant name, bootcamp name, date, skills demonstrated, facilitador signature
- Shareable (encourage LinkedIn posts)

**Post-event**:
- Take group photo (all cohort + facilitator team)
- Collect testimonial quotes (video or written)
- Upload videos to Notion (within 24 hours)
- Post to Slack #wins

**Output**: Capstone event completed, presentations recorded, photos captured, testimonials gathered

---

## T+19 to T+20: Final Assessment + Certificate Delivery

### Skills Assessment

**Responsable**: Facilitador Lead (2 hours)

**Pasos**:

1. **Administer final assessment** (if not already done):
 - Format: Quiz or project review
 - Measure: Can they demonstrate mastery of learning objectives?
 - Scoring: Pass/Fail or rubric score (0-10)
 - Example question: "Apply [concept] to solve [new problem]"

2. **Review assessment results**:
 - Calculate: % who scored ≥ 80% (target ≥ 85%)
 - Identify: Anyone below threshold (mark for additional support)
 - Synthesize: Overall skill lift from baseline to final

3. **Document findings**:
 - Spreadsheet: [Name | Baseline Score | Final Score | Delta | Proficiency Level]
 - Share with Ops for reporting

### Certificate Generation & Delivery

**Responsable**: Coordinador Ops (2 hours)

**Pasos**:

1. **Create certificates**:
 - Template: [Company logo] Certificate of Completion

**Circulate to**: CEO Delivery, Sales, Alumni Manager, Finance

### Lead Handoff

**Responsable**: Alumni Manager + Account Manager (1 hour)

**Pasos**:

1. **Segment alumni for next steps**:
 - **Bootcamp candidates** (NPS ≥ 8 + need deeper skills):
 - Tag in CRM: "Ready for BC-[next bootcamp]"
 - Assign to: Sales (conversation)
 - **Coaching candidates** (NPS 7 + individual growth):
 - Tag: "Interested in 1:1 coaching"
 - Assign to: Coaching program manager
 - **Community candidates** (high engagement, alumni champion potential):
 - Tag: "Alumni advocate"
 - Assign to: Alumni Manager (for community building)
 - **At-risk candidates** (NPS <7, disengaged):
 - Tag: "Recovery needed"
 - Assign to: Alumni Manager (re-engagement outreach)

2. **Create action plan for next 90 days**:
 - Week 1-2: Job board updates, monthly webinar
 - Week 3-4: Referral program launch (alumni bring friends)
 - Month 2: Testimonial video series
 - Month 3: Reunion event, success stories published

**Output**: Alumni segmentation complete, 90-day plan documented

---

## 30-Day Alumni Activation Plan

### Week 1 Post-Graduation
- [ ] Certificates delivered + shared
- [ ] Alumni community activated
- [ ] Job board live
- [ ] First alumni webinar date announced

### Week 2-3
- [ ] First alumni webinar held (office hours / deepdive)
- [ ] Job board updated
- [ ] Referral program announced

### Week 4
- [ ] Impact report published
- [ ] Testimonial videos released (on website, LinkedIn)
- [ ] Success story featured (1 alumni highlight)

### Month 2
- [ ] Monthly webinar series established
- [ ] Referral bonuses (if program running)
- [ ] 1:1 coaching sessions happening

### Month 3
- [ ] Alumni reunion event
- [ ] Job placement tracked (% employed in field)
- [ ] Next bootcamp applications reviewed

---

## Graduation KPIs

| KPI | Target | Owner |
|-----|--------|-------|
| **Completion rate** | ≥ 95% | Ops |
| **NPS (Bootcamp)** | ≥ 50 | Facilitador |
| **Project quality (rubric)** | ≥ 80% scored 7+/10 | Facilitador |
| **Skills assessment pass** | ≥ 85% scored ≥80% | Facilitador |
| **Certificate delivery** | 100% within T+3 | Ops |
| **Alumni engagement (T+30)** | ≥ 50% active in community | Alumni Mgr |
| **Conversion to next bootcamp** | ≥ 15% within 90 days | Sales |
| **Job placement (B2C)** | ≥ 60% within 90 days | Alumni Mgr |

---

## Casos Borde (Graduación)

**Caso 1: Squad capstone project not ready T+15 (incomplete, buggy)**
Trigger: Demo prep muestra que proyecto está rough
Decision: Options:
- Pivot to "demo mode" (concept + early-stage prototype, no full product)
- Request short extension (T+17 vs. T+16) - only if acceptable to client
- Facilitate honest presentation ("We built X, learned Y, here's roadmap")
Principle: Learning > perfection. Honest delivery > faked completion.

**Caso 2: NPS <45 (below bootcamp target)**
Trigger: Survey results muestra NPS <45, detractors >30%
Decision: Root cause analysis ASAP (T+20):
- Facilitador self-eval: ¿facilitation issue? pedagogía?
- Curriculum review: ¿content gaps? ¿pacing off?
- Logistics/tech review: ¿infrastructure blockers?
Action: Document findings, create improvement plan para próximo cohort.
Escalate to CEO if systemic issue.

**Caso 3: External guest cancels day-before capstone event**
Trigger: Mentor/speaker cancels T+15
Decision: Immediate:
- Ops finds replacement (otro facilitador, mentor, alumni)
- Or simplify agenda (skip keynote, extend networking)
- Proceed as-is; guest es nice-to-have, not critical
Principle: Event happens with or without guest.

**Caso 4: Video recording fails (capstone not captured)**
Trigger: Tech issue, presentations happened but no recording
Decision: Fallback:
- Facilitador + Asistente create "transcript" document
- Ops collects participant-submitted videos (ask squad to share phone recordings)
- Create photo gallery + testimonial quotes
Rationale: Transcript + photos preserve memory, just less polished.

**Caso 5: Participant requests certificate typo fix day-before ceremony**
Trigger: "My name is spelled wrong"
Decision: Fix immediately (15 min)
- Regenerate certificate
- Print new copy for ceremony
- Send digital version same day
Escalate if more than 1 error (data entry process issue)

**Caso 6: Alumni engagement drops week 2 post-bootcamp (only 20% active Slack)**
Trigger: Alumni channel crickets, low engagement
Decision: Alumni Manager intervenes:
- Personal outreach (not broadcast): "What would make community valuable?"
- Identify 3-4 "champions" to drive content
- Launch job board officially (if not live)
- Schedule first webinar (4 weeks post)
Principle: Community needs active cultivation, not passive waiting.

**Caso 7: Participant expressa doubt about next bootcamp interest, but was promoter (NPS 9)**
Trigger: "I loved this, but next bootcamp is expensive for me"
Decision: Account Manager conversation:
- Acknowledge value ("Glad you got value")
- Explore options (payment plan? scholarship? wait for discount?)
- No pressure; plant seed for future
Escalate to Commercial if strategic account.

---

## Anti-Patterns (QUÉ NO HACER)

- NO sacrifice capstone presentation quality for time (rehearsal is critical)
- NO ignore NPS <45 data (investigate root cause)
- NO treat alumni activation as "someone else's job" (Facilitador + Alumni Manager own it together)
- NO promise job placements directly (curate board, candidates choose)
- NO delay certificates (trust = on-time delivery)

---

## Fallbacks Operativos

| Falla | Fallback |
|-------|----------|
| Capstone project incomplete | Pivot to demo mode + roadmap presentation |
| NPS <45 | Root cause analysis, improvement plan for next cohort |
| Guest cancels | Find replacement or simplify agenda |
| Video fails | Transcript + photo gallery + testimonial quotes |
| Certificate typo | Fix + regenerate same-day |
| Alumni engagement low | Personal outreach, identify champions, launch job board |

---

**Próximo Review**: 2026-04-15 | **Dueño**: Facilitador Lead + Alumni Manager

# SOP: Onboarding Cohorte

**Versión:** 2.0 | **Vigencia:** 2026-01 | **Dueño:** Facilitador Lead | **Última Actualización:** 2026-03-24

---

## Identificación

- **Código SOP**: SOP-OC-BC
- **Proceso Padre**: Entregar Bootcamp (Ver: entregar-bootcamp-proceso.md)
- **Fase**: Onboarding Cohorte (T-7 a T-0, 7 días intensivos)
- **Responsable Principal**: Facilitador Lead (community builder, psychologically-safe culture setter)
- **Responsable Secundario**: Coordinador Ops (logistics, tech access, communications)
- **Stakeholders**: Tech Ops (platform), Squad participants, Account Manager (client)
- **Input desde**: SOP-DC-BC (curriculum + project brief)
- **Output hacia**: SOP-FS-BC (Facilitación Semanal)
- **Gate**: Cohort Readiness (T-0) - ≥95% kick-off attendance, ≥90% pre-work completion

---

## Objetivo Binario

Convertir grupo de individuos dispersos en COHORT COHESIVO con:
- [ ] Squads formados (3-4 personas, balanced skills + personalities)
- [ ] Psychological safety established (safe to struggle, ask questions)
- [ ] Pre-work completed ≥90%
- [ ] Platform access 100% funcional
- [ ] Kick-off event ≥95% asistencia
- [ ] Momentum alto hacia Week 1

---

## Supuestos & Límites

**Supuestos**:
1. Roster validada T-7 (nombres, roles, emails activos, experience levels)
2. Curriculum finalizado T-7 (project brief, learning objectives claros)
3. Slack workspace pre-created, Notion database ready
4. Facilitador Lead ha participado en ≥1 bootcamp anterior

**Límites (No cubierto)**:
- Resolución de tech issues profundas (IT support domain)
- Coaching pre-bootcamp (out of scope)
- Pre-onboarding for prerequisite knowledge (assumimos ya lo saben o facilitador lo cover in Week 1)

---

## Proceso Paso-a-Paso (T-7 a T-0)

### T-7: Cohort Formation + Welcome Package

**Responsable**: Facilitador Lead + Coordinador Ops (4 hours)

**Pasos**:

1. **Form squads** (1.5 hours):
 - Analyze cohort profile (roles, skills, personalities, backgrounds)
 - Create 3-4 squads of 3-4 people each (balanced):
 - Mix skills (not all strong, not all weak)
 - Mix personality types (not all introverts, not all extroverts)
 - Mix backgrounds/companies (if B2C)
 - Assign squad names (fun names create identity)
 - Document assignments (sheet with names, squads, emails)

2. **Create welcome email** (1 hour):
 - Subject: "You're In! Welcome to [Bootcamp Name] 🚀"
 - Content:

3. **Facilitator team final prep** (30 min):
 - Facilitador Lead + Asistente(s) sync (15 min):
 - Review final roster
 - Discuss any known challenges or needs
 - Confirm roles/responsibilities
 - Tech test (15 min):
 - Zoom call test (audio, video, screen share)
 - Slack + Notion access verify
 - Recording setup test
 - Backup plan if tech fails

**Output**: Platform access confirmed, tech tested, team aligned

---

### T-0: Kick-off Event (Live)

**Responsable**: Facilitador Lead (2-3 hours in-person/sync)

**Session Agenda**:

| Time | Activity | Facilitator | Participant Role |
|------|----------|------------|------------------|
| 0:00-0:05 | Welcome | Principal | Settle, attention |
| 0:05-0:15 | Bootcamp vision | Principal | Listen, absorb why |
| 0:15-0:25 | Ice breaker | Principal | Share, laugh, connect |
| 0:25-1:00 | Squad intros | Facilitator per squad | Introduce self, share goals |
| 1:00-1:30 | Capstone overview | Principal | Understand the project |
| 1:30-1:45 | Expectations + norms | Principal | Agree to commitments |
| 1:45-2:00 | Team photo + breakout | Asistente | Build squad bonds |

**Facilitator Talking Points**:
- "This is not a course; it's a co-creation"
- "You'll build something real in 3 weeks"
- "Your squad is your support system"
- "Failure is learning; we celebrate it"

**Expected Outcomes**:
- Participants feel welcomed + excited
- Squads have bonded (at least initial connection)
- Project is understood
- Psychological safety established (safe to struggle, ask questions)

**Post-event**:
- Take photos (with permission)
- Post group photo to Slack (#wins)
- Send recording to Slack (for those who missed)
- Squad leads post reflection to Slack

**Output**: Kick-off event completed, community activated, Week 1 momentum established

---

## Cohort Readiness Checklist

**Owner**: Facilitador Lead

**Pre-Week 1 sign-off**:
- [ ] 95%+ attended kick-off event
- [ ] 90%+ completed pre-work
- [ ] Squads formed + bonded (team photo)
- [ ] All platform access confirmed + tested
- [ ] Participants understand project + expectations
- [ ] Facilitator team briefed + confident
- [ ] Tech setup verified (Zoom, recording, Slack, Notion)
- [ ] Schedule confirmed (no conflicts, all know meeting times)

**If any box unchecked**: Escalate to Facilitador Lead for resolution (delay start if needed, but max 2-day slip)

---

## KPIs for Onboarding Phase

| Métrica | Target | Owner |
|---------|--------|-------|
| **Pre-work completion** | ≥ 90% | Facilitador |
| **Kick-off attendance** | ≥ 95% | Ops |
| **Platform adoption** | ≥ 80% active on Slack/Notion by T-0 | Tech Ops |
| **Squad cohesion** | ≥ 3/5 initial bonding | Facilitador |
| **Participant confidence** | Survey ≥ 3/5 "ready to start" | Ops |

---

## Casos Borde (Onboarding)

**Caso 1: Participante "ghost" (inscrito, no responde a comunicaciones T-5)**
Trigger: Welcome email enviado, sin respuesta, pre-work no iniciado
Decision: T-5: Follow-up call (Account Manager o Facilitador Lead)
- "Hi [name], we haven't seen you yet. Everything OK?"
- Si no responde T-4: Check in con Account Manager/client contact ("Is [person] still coming?")
- Si no confirmed T-2: Marca como "tentative", proceed sin asumir presencia
Principle: Don't wait; surface issues early

**Caso 2: Squad formed, pero uno es "outsider" (lenguaje, background, skills muy diferente)**
Trigger: Facilitador nota en kick-off que uno no encaja con su squad
Decision: Monitor Week 1, si tension visible:
- Option A: Mentoring pairing (mentor + outsider, para aceleración)
- Option B: Rebalance to another squad (week 1 only window)
- Option C: 1:1 coaching para onboarding acelerado
Principle: Inclusión es importante, pero squad cohesion también

**Caso 3: Tech platform access falla para >2 personas T-2**
Trigger: Slack bot no invitó, Notion permissions wrong, etc.
Decision: IT triage inmediata (sameday)
- Ops coordinator troubleshoots en paralelo
- If <2h fix: proceed como planeado
- If >2h fix: manual onboarding (video walk-through alternative)
Escalate: Si sigue broken T-0: notify Facilitador Lead

**Caso 4: Pre-work completion baja (<70% por T-5)**
Trigger: Menos del 70% completó pre-work assignment
Decision: T-5: Nudge email/message
- No-judgment reminder
- Offer async extension (hasta T-6 23:59)
- Offer tech support si es blocker
- Facilitador prepared para Week 1 without assuming pre-work done (reteach if needed)

**Caso 5: Kick-off event attendance drops to 80% (4 de 20 missing T-0)**
Trigger: Algunos no pueden asistir a última hora
Decision: Proceed con 16 (80% is acceptable)
- Facilitador sends recording + kick-off notes a no-shows
- Personal follow-up: "Sorry you missed it. Here's what you need to know..."
- Not dealbreaker, pero documentar reason (work, tech, personal)

---

## Anti-Patterns (QUÉ NO HACER)

- NO auto-select squads (permite clustering de skill/personality; Facilitador debe balancear)
- NO ignorar participante "ghost" pre-kick-off (escalate temprano)
- NO permitir participante optar out of kick-off ("I'll read notes later") - asistencia non-negotiable
- NO sobre-personalize pre-work (complexity frena completitud; keep simple)
- NO perder roster durante onboarding (single source of truth en shared sheet)

---

## Fallbacks Operativos

| Falla | Fallback | Owner |
|-------|----------|-------|
| Tech access fail >2 personas | Manual onboarding (video guide + personal support) | Tech Ops + Ops |
| Pre-work completion <70% | Extend deadline T-6, reteach in Week 1 if needed | Facilitador Lead |
| Kick-off attendance 80% | Proceed, send recording + notes to no-shows | Facilitador Lead |
| Squad formation incomplete T-7 | Facilitador forms manually (no esperes autoselección) | Facilitador Lead |
| Participants "ghosting" pre-T-0 | Account Manager 1:1 call ASAP | Account Manager |

---

**Próximo Review**: 2026-04-15 | **Dueño**: Facilitador Lead

# CATÁLOGO: Intervenciones de Consultoría

**Versión:** 1.0 | **Fecha:** 2026-03-24 | **Certif. Moat:** CAT-CON-2401 | **Clasificación:** Comercial

---

## INTRODUCCIÓN

MetodologIA ofrece 3 tiers de consultoría que escalan en profundidad, duración e inversión. Cada tier está diseñado para diferentes momentos del viaje del cliente y diferentes tipos de transformación.

---

## TIER 1: DIAGNÓSTICO

### Perfil Target

**Quién:** Empresas (cualquier tamaño, cualquier industria) que necesitan claridad sobre su madurez digital y próximos pasos.

**Situación Típica:**
- CEO/CTO siente que hay oportunidad en transformación pero no sabe por dónde empezar
- Empresa pasó por iniciativas anteriores que no tuvieron impacto
- Hay desalineación interna: algunos quieren cambio, otros dudan
- Necesita business case claro antes de invertir en transformación profunda

**Motivadores:**
- Claridad: ¿Dónde estamos realmente?
- Confianza: ¿Esto es posible para nosotros?
- Roadmap: ¿Cuáles son los próximos 12-24 meses?

### Objetivo del Servicio

Proveer evaluación independiente de madurez digital, identificar brechas y oportunidades, y desarrollar recomendaciones accionables + roadmap de transformación.

### Estructura & Contenido

**Fase 1: Discovery (Sem 1, 3-4 días)**
- Entrevistas: 4-6 líderes clave (CEO, CTO, CMO, COO, Head Operaciones)
- Audit técnico: Stack, infraestructura, seguridad, cloud readiness
- Audit organizacional: Procesos, roles, capacidades digitales, cultura
- Relevamiento de documentación: Estrategia digital existente, iniciativas anteriores

**Fase 2: Análisis (Sem 2, 5 días)**
- Gap analysis: Current state vs industry best practice (DART, Gartner frameworks)
- Madurez digital scoring: 0-100 por dimensión
 - Tecnología (20 pts): Cloud, AI, data, seguridad
 - Procesos (20 pts): Automatización, workflows, integración
 - People (20 pts): Skills, mentalidad digital, capacidad
 - Culture (20 pts): Apertura a cambio, velocidad, experimentación
 - Leadership (20 pts): Visión, comunicación, accountability
- Identificación de palancas: ¿Dónde > impacto con < inversión?
- ROI potencial: Estimación de ahorro/revenue upside por cada recomendación

**Fase 3: Síntesis & Recomendaciones (Sem 2-3, 4 días)**
- Redacción de reporte ejecutivo (20-30 páginas)
 - Resumen ejecutivo (3 págs): Hallazgos clave, recomendaciones top 3, next steps
 - Análisis detallado (12 págs): Scoring, gaps, benchmarks
 - Recomendaciones (5 págs): 3-5 iniciativas priorizadas, ROI, esfuerzo
 - Roadmap propuesto (timeline visual, 12-24 meses)
- Creación de scorecards visuales (Tableau/Looker si possible, o infografía)
- Desarrollo de propuesta de Tracción o Evolución (si cliente interesado)

**Fase 4: Presentación Ejecutiva (Sem 3, 2 horas)**
- Presentation de hallazgos (45 min): storytelling, números, insights clave
- Q&A (45 min): Responder dudas, validar hipótesis
- Propuesta de siguiente paso (30 min): Tracción vs Evolución, inversión, timeline

### Entregables

1. **Reporte Diagnóstico Completo** (30 págs PDF)
 - Executive summary (3 págs)
 - Análisis detallado de madurez (10 págs)
 - Recomendaciones estratégicas (5 págs)
 - Roadmap de transformación (3 págs)
 - Apéndices: Metodología, benchmarks, entrevistas (5 págs)

2. **Scorecard Visual** (1 hoja)
 - Gráfico radar de madurez digital (5 dimensiones)
 - Comparación vs industria
 - Priorización visual de oportunidades

3. **Roadmap Timeline** (1 visual)
 - 24 meses plan de implementación
 - Fases, hitos, inversión, ROI

4. **Propuesta de Siguiente Paso** (2 págs)
 - Opción A: Tracción (6 sem, $18M)
 - Opción B: Evolución (16 sem, $35M)
 - Qué se lograría en cada caso

### Costo

**Gratuito para clientes B2B** (objetivo: generar 40%+ conversión a Tracción/Evolución)

**Startups <10 empleados, <3 años:** Tarifa B2C ($2-3M COP)

### Metodología

**Frameworks utilizados:**
- DART (Digital Adoption Readiness Template) — madurez digital
- Gartner CIO Priorities — benchmarking vs industria
- McKinsey 7S — análisis organizacional
- Balanced Scorecard — definición de KPIs
- Design thinking — ideación de soluciones

### Timeline

- Sem 1: Discovery (5 días)
- Sem 2: Análisis (4 días)
- Sem 2-3: Síntesis & reporte (4 días)
- Sem 3: Presentation (2 horas)
- Total: 3 semanas

## TIER 2: TRACCIÓN

### Perfil Target

**Quién:** Clientes que pasaron Diagnóstico (o saben qué quieren) y buscan quick wins, prueba de concepto, cambio ágil.

**Situación Típica:**
- Leadership quiere "ver movimiento" en 4-8 semanas
- Presupuesto limitado, necesita ROI claro rápido
- Equipo está motivado pero no sabe por dónde empezar
- Hay un "pain point" específico que duele ahora

**Motivadores:**
- Velocidad: Resultados en 4-8 semanas, no años
- Prueba: Demostración de que el cambio es posible
- Capacidad: Aprender a cambiar rapidamente

### Objetivo del Servicio

Implementación rápida de 2-3 iniciativas de alto impacto que generan ROI claro, demuestran viabilidad, y crean momentum de cambio organizacional.

### Estructura & Contenido

**Fase 1: Sprint Planning (Sem 1, Día 1-3)**
- Kick-off con stakeholders clave
- Identificación de 2-3 objetivos SMART (4-8 semanas)
- Definición de equipo de cambio interno (3-5 personas dedicated)
- Desglose de sprints: Qué se logra cada semana

**Sprint Típico (2 semanas):**
- Lun-Mar: Planning, educación, prototipado
- Mié-Jue: Piloto/test con usuarios finales
- Vie: Demo, feedback, ajustes
- + Daily stand-ups, soporte ad-hoc

**Fases Iniciales de Iteración:**

- **Sprint A (Sem 1-2): Quick Win 1**
 - Ej: Nuevo workflow de aprobaciones (ahorra 10h/semana)
 - Ej: Integración de sistemas (elimina data entry manual)
 - Ej: Programa de capacitación digital (upskill equipo)
 - Output: Proceso nuevo en producción, usuarios entrenados

- **Sprint B (Sem 3-4): Quick Win 2**
 - Ej: Automación de reporting (data-driven decisions)
 - Ej: Nueva plataforma de colaboración (velocidad comunicación)
 - Ej: Rediseño de customer experience (NPS +10 pts)
 - Output: Métrica de impacto medida, teams usando

- **Sprint C (Sem 5-6, Opcional): Quick Win 3 o Profundización**
 - Opción A: Tercer quick win independiente
 - Opción B: Profundización de impacto de Win 1 & 2 (rollout a más áreas)

**Fase 2: Medición & Comunicación (Sem 6-8)**
- Cálculo de impacto: Ahorro de horas, costo, calidad, velocidad, NPS
- Business case documentado: "Invertimos $18M, generamos $40M de valor"
- Comunicación interna: Celebración, storytelling, evangelización
- Documentación: Playbooks para que equipo mantenga

**Fase 3: Handoff & Decisión (Sem 8)**
- Transición a equipo interno
- Training de "super users" o process owners
- Decisión: ¿Recompran Evolución (transformación profunda)? ¿Otra Tracción en área diferente?

### Entregables

1. **Sprint Reports** (semanal)
 - Progreso vs plan
 - Blockers & mitigation
 - Preview de próximo sprint

2. **Business Case & ROI** (1-2 págs)
 - Metrics baseline & post-implementation
 - Ahorro/revenue, ROI multiplier
 - Comparación con inversión

3. **Playbooks & Documentación** (3-5 documentos)
 - "Cómo usar el nuevo proceso"
 - "Troubleshooting común"
 - "Quién llamar si hay problemas"

4. **Capacitación** (2-3 sesiones, 2h c/una)
 - Para users finales: Cómo usar nuevo proceso
 - Para managers: Cómo monitorear + mantener
 - Para IT (si aplica): Cómo soportar

5. **Propuesta de Recompra** (opcional)
 - ¿Quieren escalar a otro área/proceso?
 - ¿Quieren profundizar con Evolución?

### Costo

**$18M COP** (4-8 semanas de consultoría senior)

### Duración

4-8 semanas (típicamente 6)

### Modelo

- 1 Consultor Senior (full-time, lead)
- 1-2 Especialistas temáticos (part-time, según iniciativas)
- Daily contact con cliente (stand-ups, demos, meetings)

## TIER 3: EVOLUCIÓN

### Perfil Target

**Quién:** Clientes que pasaron Tracción (o saben necesitan transformación profunda) y buscan rediseño sistémico, cambio cultural, sostenibilidad de largo plazo.

**Situación Típica:**
- Quieren transformación de modelo operativo, no quick fixes
- Tienen presupuesto y tiempo (12-24 semanas)
- Necesitan embedding con equipo, no consultoría de "sobrevuelo"
- Objetivo: Que equipo interno sea capaz de mantener + escalar cambio

**Motivadores:**
- Profundidad: Transformación real, no parches
- Capacidad interna: Desarrollo de consultores internos
- Sostenibilidad: Cambio que perdura

### Objetivo del Servicio

Co-crear modelo operativo nuevo, liderar change management, transferir capacidad a equipo interno para que sustenten transformación post-consultoría.

### Estructura & Contenido

**Fase 1: Diagnóstico Profundo (Sem 1-2, 10 días)**
- Deep-dive interviews: 20-30 personas (roles, niveles diferentes)
- Process mapping: End-to-end de procesos críticos
- Análisis de data, sistemas, arquitectura técnica
- Evaluación de capacidades, skills, mentalidad
- Identificación de "pain points" raíz vs síntomas

**Fase 2: Co-Diseño del Modelo Operativo (Sem 3-6, 20 días)**
- Workshops de design thinking (2-3 días intensivos)
- Co-crear: Roles, procesos, tecnología, estructuras de decisión
- Prototipado: Piloto en 1-2 áreas antes de scale
- Validación con leadership: ¿Es vistazo de futuro realista y deseado?

**Fase 3: Change Management & Implementación (Sem 7-18, 60 días)**
- Comunicación estratégica: Storytelling, ritmo, cascada de mensajes
- Capacitación estructurada: 3-5 sesiones por grupo (users, managers, líderes)
- Mentoría de change champions: 2-3 personas internas que lideran cambio
- Support en vivo: Ajustes, troubleshooting, re-inspiración
- Weekly pulse checks: ¿Cómo va adoption? ¿Dónde resistencia?

**Fase 4: Knowledge Transfer (Sem 15-22, 35 días)**
- Documentación completa: Playbooks, decision frameworks, KPIs
- Entrenamiento de "internal consultants": 2-3 personas capaces de liderar cambio sin consultor
- Capstone proyecto: Equipo interno lidera iniciativa nueva sin soporte

**Fase 5: Handoff & Sostenibilidad (Sem 20-24, 25 días)**
- QBR trimestral: Cómo va el modelo nuevo? (3 meses post-engagement)
- Monitoreo de KPIs: Métrica de éxito
- Ajustes necesarios: Soporte limitado, pago por hora (opcional)
- Documentación de learnings: Escalabilidad, próximas etapas

### Entregables

1. **Diagnóstico Completo** (30-40 págs)
 - Estado actual detallado
 - Pain points raíz, análisis de causas
 - Oportunidades de transformación

2. **Modelo Operativo Diseñado** (visual + 20 págs descripción)
 - Estructura organizacional nueva (org chart, roles, skills)
 - Procesos rediseñados (flowcharts, RACI, decision frameworks)
 - Plataformas/tecnología (stack, arquitectura, integración)
 - Culture framework (valores, comportamientos, incentivos)

3. **Change Plan** (10 págs)
 - Comunicación: Mensajes, timing, canales, líderes
 - Capacitación: Currículum por grupo, facilitadores, métricas
 - Timeline: Fases de roll-out, hitos, dependencias
 - Governance: Quien decide, escalations, tracking

4. **Playbooks & Documentación** (10-20 documentos)
 - "Cómo usar el nuevo proceso" (3-5 playbooks)
 - "Decision framework" (cómo tomamos decisiones)
 - "KPI dashboard" (métricas de éxito, cómo leerlas)
 - "Troubleshooting" (problemas comunes, soluciones)
 - "Role descriptions" (qué hace cada rol, skills, expectations)

5. **Change Champion Handbook** (5 págs)
 - Visión, objetivos, palancas de cambio
 - Cómo lidera sin ser "la autoridad"
 - Recursos, soporte, escalations
 - Métricas de éxito

6. **Post-Implementation Support** (3 meses, 1x/mes)
 - QBR: Cómo va? Métricas progresando?
 - Ajustes: Cambios necesarios
 - Re-inspiración: Refocusing si momentum baja
 - Prep para sostenibilidad: Cómo el equipo mantiene esto sin nosotros

### Costo

**$35M COP** (16 semanas, embedded team)

### Duración

12-24 semanas (típicamente 16)

### Modelo

- Director de Consultoría (oversight, 5h/sem)
- 1 Consultor Senior full-time (líder del proyecto)
- 1-2 Especialistas temáticos (part-time según necesidad)
- +Coaching/training facilitators

## VÍAS DE ENTRADA & CONTINUIDAD

**Entrada a DIAGNÓSTICO:**
- Cualquier empresa (B2B gratuito, startups pagado)
- Requisito: Conversación discovery de 60 min
- Proceso: Propuesta → contrato → kick-off

**Entrada a TRACCIÓN:**
- Opción A: Post-Diagnóstico (40% + conversion)
- Opción B: Directo (si cliente sabe qué quiere)
- Requisito: Problema específico, equipo dedicado, presupuesto
- Proceso: Propuesta Tracción → contrato → kick-off

**Entrada a EVOLUCIÓN:**
- Opción A: Post-Tracción (30%+ upgrade)
- Opción B: Directo (si transformación profunda clara)
- Requisito: Sponsor fuerte, equipo dedicado, 16 semanas, presupuesto $35M
- Proceso: Propuesta Evolución → contrato → kick-off

**Continuidad & Escalamiento:**
- Diagnóstico → Tracción (mostrar valor, generar momentum)
- Tracción → Evolución (escalar a transformación profunda)
- Evolución → Sostenibilidad (QBR, soporte ongoing)
- Tracción → Otra Tracción (area diferente, pain point diferente)
- Post-éxito → Referral (cliente refiere otros)

## SUPUESTOS EXPLÍCITOS

1. **Cliente tiene visión de futuro, aunque incompleta:** Diagnóstico asume que hay dirección estratégica. Si cliente está sin visión (nuevo CEO, pivoting), diagnóstico requiere +50% de time.

2. **Madurez digital es medible en 5 dimensiones:** Usamos Tech, Process, People, Culture, Leadership como marco. Si cliente opera en industria única (ej: minería ancestral), ajuste de framework necesario.

3. **Quick wins existen y son realizables en 4-8 semanas:** Tracción asume que hay al menos 2 problemas "no-brainers" que se resuelven rápido. Si cliente es "todo complicado", Tracción no es el tier.

4. **Equipo cliente aprende en tiempo real:** Evolución asume absorción de metodología durante engagement. Si equipo es "transaction-focused" (solo ejecuta instrucciones), knowledge transfer fracasa.

5. **ROI es medible en métricas operacionales:** Tiers asumen que cambio deja rastro (horas, costo, velocidad, NPS). Si cliente no tiene baseline metrics, medición post ex-ante.

---

## LÍMITES

**DIAGNÓSTICO:**
- No es auditoría de compliance/riesgo (refiere a audit firms)
- No incluye benchmarking competidor detallado (opinión, no datos)
- No rediseña estrategia corporativa (la toma como input)
- Máx 4 semanas, si se extiende = cliente necesita Tracción antes de Diagnóstico

**TRACCIÓN:**
- Solo 2-3 quick wins simultáneos (más = caos)
- No substituye PMO del cliente (somos coaches de cambio, no project management office)
- Requiere presupuesto dedicado (no puedo implementar sin inversión)
- No resuelve conflictos políticos (si hay, referir a Evolución que los aborda)

**EVOLUCIÓN:**
- Mínimo 12 semanas (menos no justifica embedded approach)
- Requiere sponsor C-level disponible ≥2h/semana (non-negotiable)
- No sustituye equipo interno permanente (somos mentores, no staff)
- Máx 24 semanas (más = cliente debe internalizar con internal consultants)

**NO APLICA A:**
- Industrias donde regulación prohíbe cambio (fintech pre-aprobación, utilities, defensa)
- Orgs en crisis aguda (primero stabilizar financiero, después transformar)
- Clientes buscando "cheap consulting" (nuestro floor es rigor, no descuento)

## CRITERIOS DE ACEPTACIÓN

### DIAGNÓSTICO
- ✅ Reporte con ≥3 recomendaciones, cada una con palanca de impacto clara
- ✅ Scorecard madurez completado (5 dimensiones, comparativa vs industria)
- ✅ Roadmap visual 24-meses con fases, hitos, inversión estimada
- ✅ Leadership expresa clarity ≥7/10 en próximos pasos (pre-presentación 1:1 con sponsor)
- ✅ Conversión decidida: Cliente elige Tracción, Evolución, pausa, o "no"

### TRACCIÓN
- ✅ ≥2 de 3 quick wins completados con métrica base vs post documentada
- ✅ Business case: ROI ≥2x inversión, ahorro/revenue estimado vs realizado
- ✅ Playbooks entregados + equipo interno "super users" capacitado
- ✅ Cliente puede operar cambio sin nosotros (test: "Sin consultor, ¿ustedes pueden mantenerlo?")

### EVOLUCIÓN
- ✅ Modelo operativo nuevo documentado (org chart + procesos + tech + culture framework)
- ✅ ≥80% de equipo usando nuevo proceso (sem 8 de 16)
- ✅ ≥2-3 internal consultants certificados (capstone project liderado por ellos solo)
- ✅ KPIs mejorando trend positivo (medidos desde sem 1 a sem 20)
- ✅ QBR 3-meses post muestra modelo persiste sin decaimiento
